query:
SELECT 
            vr.id,
            vr.type_reaction,
            vr.user_id,
            COALESCE(u.nom_complet, u.email) as user_name,
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM vr.created_at) as timestamp
        FROM video_reactions vr
        LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = vr.user_id
        WHERE vr.video_id = $1
        ORDER BY vr.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 100
